seedItems.title: Allocation engine: move the input total next to the allocation loop

seededDefectKey.scenario: A cost item matches no rule and has no projectId (the unmatched branch `continue`s before the moved line).
seededDefectKey.consequence: totalInputAmount silently drops unmatched spend, so input and allocated totals agree while real spend is missing from the report.

seedItems.title: Run summary: "simplify" the matched-rules counter

seededDefectKey.scenario: A tenant has several active rules and only one of them matches this month's cost items.
seededDefectKey.consequence: summary.matchedRules reports every active rule (rules.length), not the rules that matched, so the run summary overstates rule coverage.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The same defect already ships in the delivered code (senior review F9).
seededDefectKey.consequence: Reviewers who accept the patch re-introduce the exact defect the review guide ranks as F9.

tests.name: counts only the rules that matched an item
tests.code: const s = mod.computeSummary([{ amount: 100, tags: { team: 'core' } }], [{ matchTagKey: 'team', matchTagValue: 'core' }, { matchTagKey: 'team', matchTagValue: 'infra' }]); assert.equal(s.matchedRules, 1);

tests.name: zero matches reports zero matched rules
tests.code: const s = mod.computeSummary([{ amount: 5, tags: {} }], [{ matchTagKey: 'team', matchTagValue: 'core' }]); assert.equal(s.matchedRules, 0); assert.equal(s.unmatchedLineItems, 1);
